title: Physics: Particle Reconstruction and General Relativity
description: A folder of research papers. Relativity: Reconciling the Schwarzschild Solution with Conservation of Mass-Energy, version 1.0.0, the current paper; Why Is It Impossible to Escape from a Black Hole?, version 1.3.2, superseded by it. Validation: the redshift data for observations with large redshifts (Section 19 of the second paper); the pulse-profile calculation on NASA's NICER observations is in its own repository (https://github.com/ChrisBergstromBeamish/fast-nicer-pulse-profile-modeling). Internal Spaces: Spin from Internal Geometry, an internal space that provides spin. Not peer-reviewed.
notes: Not peer-reviewed. Versions 1.0.0 to 1.3.2 of this record held the first paper alone, Why Is It Impossible to Escape from a Black Hole? (versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 titled 'Do All Frames of Reference Have the Same Yardstick?'; version 1.3.2: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24544542; the DOIs of every version are in RELEASE.md). Version 2.0.0 is the first to hold the whole folder: the second paper, Reconciling the Schwarzschild Solution with Conservation of Mass-Energy, at version 1.0.0, in a release for the first time; the first paper unchanged but for one line on its folder page saying that it is superseded; the redshift data; and the first document on internal spaces.
